description: Sealing to an identity and its devices: sealed_content, device encryption keys in the device certificate (tag 0xC010), the signed device_list with the receiver rules, and device_signed objects (Ed25519 and ML-DSA-65).

sealedContent.name: identityAndTwoDevices
sealedContent.description: Identity key first, then devices A and B

sealedContent.name: identityOnly
sealedContent.description: An identity without devices: one wrap

sealedContent.name: emptyPlaintext
sealedContent.description: An empty plaintext still has a tag and a commitment

sealedContent.name: unknownOptionalTagIsIgnored
sealedContent.description: An extension tag in the optional range (0xC001) is ignored by a reader that does not know it

sealedRejected.name: keyThatHoldsNoWrap
sealedRejected.description: A device that is not a recipient

sealedRejected.name: contextOfAnotherPurpose
sealedRejected.description: The reader expects the label share-key

sealedRejected.name: ciphertextBitFlipped
sealedRejected.description: One bit of the content ciphertext flipped

sealedRejected.name: mlkemCiphertextOfTheWrapFlipped
sealedRejected.description: A bit of the ML-KEM ciphertext inside the first wrap flipped: implicit rejection gives another secret, the wrap does not open

sealedRejected.name: ephemeralX25519OfTheWrapFlipped
sealedRejected.description: A bit of the ephemeral X25519 key inside the wrap flipped

sealedRejected.name: senderWrapsAnotherContentKeyForADevice
sealedRejected.description: Equivocation: the identity wrap holds the real content key, the device wrap another one. The identity reads the message, the device refuses it (see the positive check in the validator)

sealedRejected.name: seventeenWraps
sealedRejected.description: More wraps than the limit of 16

sealedRejected.name: criticalUnknownTag
sealedRejected.description: A critical extension tag (0x8001) the reader does not know

sealedRejected.name: contextUppercase
sealedRejected.description: A context outside a-z, 0-9, dot, underscore, hyphen

sealRejected.name: seventeenRecipients
sealRejected.description: One more recipient than the limit of 16

sealRejected.name: lowOrderX25519Key
sealRejected.description: A recipient X25519 key that is the all-zero low-order point

sealRejected.name: unreducedMlKemKey
sealRejected.description: A recipient ML-KEM key with a coefficient not reduced modulo q (FIPS 203 modulus check)

sealRejected.name: contextWithASpace
sealRejected.description: A context label with a space

deviceListsRejected.name: listForAnotherTrustedIdentity
deviceListsRejected.description: The list is valid but the receiver trusts another identity for this issuer

deviceListsRejected.name: signedByADevice
deviceListsRejected.description: A malicious paired device signs a list with its device keys under the identity public keys

deviceListsRejected.name: entryChangedAfterSigning
deviceListsRejected.description: A device encryption key swapped after signing (a lying server adds its own key)

deviceListsRejected.name: lifetimeOverSevenDays
deviceListsRejected.description: expires_at_ms is 7 days and 1 ms after issued_at_ms

deviceListsRejected.name: issuedMoreThanFiveMinutesAhead
deviceListsRejected.description: issued_at_ms 6 minutes after the verifier clock

deviceListsRejected.name: sixteenDevices
deviceListsRejected.description: More devices than the limit of 15

deviceListsRejected.name: entryWithLowOrderKey
deviceListsRejected.description: A device entry with an all-zero X25519 key

deviceListsRejected.name: trailingEntryByte
deviceListsRejected.description: device entries one byte too long

receiverSequence.name: onlyTheIdentityKeyWithoutDevices
receiverSequence.description: No device is listed: the identity key is the only recipient

receiverSequence.name: revisionTwoApplies
receiverSequence.description: Revision 2 lists devices A and B (stored in device_id order)

receiverSequence.name: olderRevisionIsNotApplied
receiverSequence.description: Revision 1 again: a lying server replays an older list

receiverSequence.name: identityThenDevicesInOrder
receiverSequence.description: Identity key, then A, then B

receiverSequence.name: revocationStatementIsHeld
receiverSequence.description: The receiver holds the identity statement of version 1 that revokes device B

receiverSequence.name: revokedDeviceIsSkipped
receiverSequence.description: Device B is revoked by the statement the receiver holds, although the list (revision 2) still names it

receiverSequence.name: expiredCertificateIsSkipped
receiverSequence.description: One day later the certificates of A and B have expired

receiverSequence.name: staleListAddsNoDevice
receiverSequence.description: At expires_at_ms the list adds no device

receiverSequence.name: revisionThreeApplies
receiverSequence.description: Revision 3 (A, B and C; it carries revocation_version 1 and names B because this fixture has not removed it)

receiverSequence.name: revisionThreeStillHonoursTheStatement
receiverSequence.description: Device B stays skipped because of the statement

receiverSequence.name: pinnedEncryptionKeysDiffer
receiverSequence.description: The receiver already trusts other identity encryption keys for this identity: a list that carries different ones is refused

deviceSigned.name: deviceSignsWithBothAlgorithms
deviceSigned.description: Device A signs with its own Ed25519 and ML-DSA-65 keys and attaches its certificate

deviceSigned.name: certificateKnownToTheVerifier
deviceSigned.description: The certificate is not attached: the verifier holds it under its SHA-384 hash

deviceSignedRejected.name: ed25519SignatureOnly
deviceSignedRejected.description: The ML-DSA-65 part is missing: an Ed25519-only device signature is refused

deviceSignedRejected.name: mlDsaPartFromAnotherSigner
deviceSignedRejected.description: The Ed25519 part is the device and the ML-DSA part is a stranger's signature

deviceSignedRejected.name: bodyChanged
deviceSignedRejected.description: The body differs from the signed one

deviceSignedRejected.name: deviceOfAnotherIdentity
deviceSignedRejected.description: The certificate is issued by an identity the verifier does not trust for this signer

deviceSignedRejected.name: certificateExpired
deviceSignedRejected.description: The certificate expired one day later

deviceSignedRejected.name: certificateNotAvailable
deviceSignedRejected.description: No certificate attached and none known

deviceSignedRejected.name: certificateHashDoesNotMatch
deviceSignedRejected.description: The attached certificate is another device certificate than the hash names

deviceSignedRejected.name: deviceIsRevoked
deviceSignedRejected.description: The verifier holds a revocation statement that revokes device A

deviceSignedRejected.name: deviceIssuedItsOwnCertificate
deviceSignedRejected.description: A malicious device signs its own certificate with its device keys: the chain to the identity does not verify
